prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A chubby cartoon baby giraffe drawn in a soft, glossy 3D-render style like a plush vinyl toy, standing upright on two stubby hind legs against a plain pale-yellow background. Its body is round and pear-shaped with a big soft belly, its neck is short and thick rather than long, and its head is oversized — nearly half its total height — with a wide rounded muzzle, two tiny fuzzy ossicone horns tipped in brown, small floppy ears, and warm cream-and-caramel patchwork spots with soft edges. Color palette: buttery yellow, milky cream, light caramel brown, tiny pink blush circles on the cheeks. The face is frozen mid-explosion of laughter: eyes squeezed shut into two upward-curving crescent slits with tiny crinkle lines at the corners, eyebrows raised high, mouth stretched enormously wide open in a huge grin showing a pink tongue and a single row of tiny blunt white teeth, head tilted back slightly, one stubby hoof-hand pressed against its own belly and the other flung out to the side. A couple of small cartoon tear droplets fly from the corners of its eyes, and simple radiating motion lines and small sparkle marks around the head suggest loud, helpless, wheezing laughter. Thick clean outlines, smooth cel-shaded highlights, no texture noise, centered full-body composition, square framing, sticker-like simplicity, exaggerated comedic expression, cute and derpy rather than realistic, no text or lettering anywhere in the image.
